note: Shoshone NF (Clarks Fork RD) camping area in Sunlight Basin, about 9 miles in on gravel Forest Road 101 off the Chief Joseph Scenic Highway (WY-296). Sites under pine and juniper with tables and bear boxes; no fire rings, no garbage pickup, no cell service. Popular with riders, but horse corrals and trailer parking are at the separate trailhead nearby. --Claude
